brief.text:
GANGSTAS PARADISE (Sleeper) — lineup holds, every Wednesday injury tag still trending toward playing Sunday
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none — this roster has no Wed/Thu games; first kickoff is Sunday (Herbert/Hampton 1:25 PM PT vs ARI)
Lineup: no changes. Higgins (heel) was a DNP Wednesday but Zac Taylor calls it minor and expects him back Sunday vs TB; Flowers (quad) is back at practice and Baltimore is optimistic for Sunday vs IND; Tuten was sent home sick Wednesday but Jacksonville's own coach indicated nothing beyond the illness; Downs (calf) practiced Tuesday and is trending to clear the injury report entirely. If Higgins, Flowers, or Downs is out: start Stefon Diggs. If Tuten is out: start Woody Marks.
Waivers / trades: TE is still your one real hole, and Chase Brown's own Bengals backup Samaje Perine is confirmed available too — see the Waivers tab. No new trade idea this run; the Diggs-for-Ferguson pitch from Tuesday still stands if you want to send it.

GAME OF THROWS (Yahoo) — Myers opens your Week 1 tonight, rest of the lineup holds
Do now: nothing needs a change before tonight's kickoff
Locks next 24h: Jason Myers (SEA) vs NE — tonight, 5:20 PM PT, the first lock of your entire Week 1
Lineup: no changes from Tuesday. Etienne's workload just got a lift — Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL) is trending toward sitting out New Orleans' opener, clearing the runway for Etienne regardless of how the DET matchup grades out. Judkins still owns the toughest matchup and lowest implied team total (16.0) on either roster but stays in — no better flex on the bench. Parker Washington and Likely remain clean starts.
Waivers / trades: still no Yahoo free-agent visibility this run (private league, screenshots only) — drop a fresh Available-Players screenshot into the War room folder and next run can give real bid guidance; see the Waivers tab. No trade this run.

FYI: Chase Brown starts in both leagues; Michael Wilson sits on both benches; four Jacksonville pieces are rostered across the two leagues (Tuten, Strange, Jaguars D/ST, Parker Washington). Chargers lost starting center Tyler Biadasz for the season (ACL) and Rashawn Slater missed practice — worth tracking for Herbert/Hampton's blocking, though the plus ARI matchup absorbs it for now.

waivers.text:
SLEEPER — TE is still the priority: you roster zero backup there, and Strange shares Week 7's JAX/LAC bye cluster with Herbert, Hampton, Tuten, and your DEF. FAAB budget is untouched at $100 (nobody in the league has spent a dollar yet) and you sit waiver position 3.
1. Darren Waller (TE, CAR) — Carolina's TE2 on the depth chart behind Tommy Tremble but the far more proven player with real path to the job. Drop Fernando Mendoza (your QB3, confirmed as Vegas' backup behind Kirk Cousins — zero standalone value). FAAB $9.
2. Samaje Perine (RB, CIN) — the direct backup to Chase Brown, who anchors your RB1 slot in BOTH leagues; this is bye-week and injury insurance you don't currently have anywhere on either roster. Drop Zachariah Branch (WR, no role in ATL). FAAB $7.
3. Justice Hill (RB, BAL) — locked in as Derrick Henry's clear #2 and the passing-down back in a full-PPR league; real standalone flex value. Drop Zavion Thomas (WR, no role in CHI). FAAB $6.
4. AJ Barner (TE, SEA) — second TE flier if you miss on Waller or want a true pair. Drop Michael Wilson (WR, buried behind Marvin Harrison Jr./Trey McBride in the ARI target mix, no path to a role). FAAB $4.
5. Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI) — cheap speculative stash in a muddled Bears backfield. Only add if you're willing to also cut Woody Marks or Stefon Diggs — your 6 bench spots are full once picks 1-4 land. FAAB $3.
No DEF/K stream needed this week — Aubrey and the Jaguars D&ST both carry plus Week 1 matchups per the Analysis tab.

YAHOO — still no access to the Yahoo free-agent pool this run (private league, no login, screenshots only). Isaiah Likely being confirmed healthy lowers urgency at TE, but Chig Okonkwo remains a thin TE2 if you want a stopgap plan. Drop a fresh screenshot of the free-agent list (Players > Available, filtered by position) into the War room Drive folder and next run can give you real availability and bid guidance.

trades.text:
SLEEPER — send Stefon Diggs to Grandmasterfabe ("Master Bate$ LaPortapotty") for Jake Ferguson (TE, DAL). Diggs is stuck behind Higgins, Flowers, and Downs on your bench with no path to starting reps; Grandmasterfabe is stacked at WR (Olave, DeVonta Smith, Jameson Williams, Jakobi Meyers, Alec Pierce) but is rolling with rookie Harold Fannin as their only real TE, with Ferguson buried as insurance. Diggs gives them a proven bye-week/injury-fill starter; you turn a fully blocked bench piece into the backup TE you currently have nowhere on the roster, which matters with Strange sharing the Week 7 JAX/LAC bye cluster. It's a mild overpay in raw value on your side, justified by how scarce TE depth is around this league right now — nobody scanned so far is sitting on two startable options. Checked your Weeks 15-17 outlook first: Diggs isn't projected to be a playoff starter behind your current WR corps, so moving him costs you nothing down the stretch.

YAHOO — no trade idea this run. I don't have visibility into other managers' rosters or trade blocks in your private Yahoo league (screenshots only cover your team and this week's opponent), so I can't responsibly name a real deal. No trade.txt found in the War room folder either.

news.headline: Bengals' Tee Higgins: Dealing with heel injury
news.summary: Higgins was a non-participant in Wednesday's practice with a heel contusion, but coach Zac Taylor calls it minor and expects him ready for Sunday's opener.

news.headline: Ravens news: Zay Flowers gets Week 1 injury update after missing practice time
news.summary: Flowers is back at practice on his quad injury and the Ravens are optimistic he'll be available Sunday against the Colts.

news.headline: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten idle with illness
news.summary: Tuten was sent home sick from Wednesday's practice, but Jacksonville's coaching staff indicated it's nothing beyond the illness itself ahead of Sunday's opener.

news.headline: Josh Downs (calf) practices Tuesday
news.summary: Downs returned to practice Tuesday and is trending to clear his calf injury designation entirely before Sunday.

news.headline: Fantasy Football Start 'Em, Sit 'Em: Week 1 Picks
news.summary: Likely is healthy and locked in as the Giants' starting tight end, with experts pegging him for TE1 upside against a Dallas defense that graded near the bottom of the league last season.

news.headline: Parker Washington (undisclosed) day-to-day
news.summary: The undisclosed issue that had Washington day-to-day in late August has resolved and he carries no injury designation into Week 1.

news.headline: Saints Add Intrigue to Alvin Kamara, Travis Etienne Battle Before Week 1
news.summary: Alvin Kamara is trending toward sitting out the Saints' opener with a knee/MCL sprain, which would hand Etienne the clear lead-back workload against Detroit.
